page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r9ae.24xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual instance running on KVM hypervisors. It is equipped with 96 dedicated vCPUs driven by an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9T95 processor with a base clock frequency of 2.25 GHz. Memory capacity reaches 768.0 GB, providing an 8:1 memory-to-core allocation of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

The instance does not include integrated local storage, requiring attached cloud storage volumes for all file system persistence and disk operations. Network architecture features a baseline throughput of 50 Gbps. It contains no specialized hardware accelerators or GPUs, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

With its 8 GB per vCPU ratio, the system offers high memory density relative to compute allocation, optimizing cost efficiency for memory-bound tasks where large RAM arrays are necessary without overprovisioning processor cycles. Tradeoffs include complete dependence on remote networked block storage for disk I/O.

This hardware footprint matches large enterprise in-memory databases, distributed caches such as Redis or Memcached clusters, in-memory analytics engines, big data processing pipelines, and high-concurrency enterprise applications.
